description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named CandidateHistorySearchFilterParams, used to encapsulate filter parameters for searching candidate history records in the recruitment module. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes properties for candidate ID and action IDs, along with configuration for sorting.

classes.name: CandidateHistorySearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for filtering candidate history search results, including candidate ID and action IDs, and sorting configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with default sorting by performed date in descending order.

methods.name: getCandidateId
methods.description: Returns the candidate ID used as filter.

methods.name: setCandidateId
methods.description: Sets the candidate ID filter parameter.

methods.name: getActionIds
methods.description: Returns the array of action IDs used as filter.

methods.name: setActionIds
methods.description: Sets the array of action IDs filter parameter.
